name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: How Jordan became a target for Iran in war with U.S.
changes.summary: Since the Iran war began in February, Jordan has largely avoided the kind of onslaught Tehran has aimed at places like Kuwait, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. With recent attacks, and one that killed three U.S. soldiers, that's changed. CBS News senior national security correspondent Charlie D'Agata examines why.

changes.title: Iran war and Trump tariffs fuel higher gas prices and renewed inflation risks
changes.summary: The affordability crisis is revving up again. The war in Iran and Trump’s tariffs are pushing prices up and raising fears of renewed inflation.

changes.title: Opposing Defense Bill, Democrats Shift Their Tactics
changes.summary: Crossing what was once seen as a political red line, Democrats voted against the usually bipartisan measure, registering dissent about the war in Iran.

changes.title: Iran Journey Reveals Society’s Wartime Defiance and Hope
changes.summary: From the capital, Tehran, to the holy city of Mashhad, the Iran I saw was a nation of many layers: defiant but also weary, despairing but hopeful.

changes.title: Week in Politics: Iran War; Trump attends solemn ritual; nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia
changes.summary: The Trump administration is seeking tens of billions of dollars in supplemental appropriations for the Iran War, a war which the president and allies have repeatedly claimed is already won.

changes.title: Opposing Defense Bill, Democrats Shift Their Tactics
changes.summary: Crossing what was once seen as a political red line, Democrats voted against the usually bipartisan measure, registering dissent about the war in Iran.

changes.title: Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia as Middle East war widens
changes.summary: Yemeni rebels accuse Saudis of ‘dangerous escalation’ as tit-for-tat strikes mark new front in war that has engulfed region Iran-backed Houthi rebels vowed to retaliate against Saudi Arabia on Saturday after they accused the kingdom of targeting civilian infrastructure, as the Middle East war widens across the region.

changes.title: Iran War and Trump’s Tariffs Threaten a Resilient U.S. Economy
changes.summary: As renewed fighting with Iran sends oil and gas prices soaring, President Trump has imposed new global tariffs that could push up prices further.

changes.title: Mixed close on Wall Street amid U.S.-Iran fighting, new Trump tariffs
changes.summary: Stock markets closed mixed on Friday as the Iran war continues to upend energy prices. CBS News MoneyWatch correspondent Kelly O'Grady has more.

changes.title: Cornell, Northwestern and Other Universities Plan for Classes at Middle East Campuses
changes.summary: Even after the collapse of the cease-fire between the United States and Iran, American universities expect to teach in Qatar and the United Arab Emirates, and a new outpost is on track to open in Saudi Arabia.
